method: Primary PDFs downloaded and extracted with pypdf. Financial tables visually inspected with pypdfium2 rendering. Document-date assertions come from the covers and are separate from verified publication timestamps.

guidance.basis: Reported annual capex under Project Spring
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
guidance.note: Compares the annual FY26 spending target with full-year spending, not the 9M interim total. Annual capex budget achievement does not prove capacity commissioning or return on investment.

targetEvidence.title: Earnings-call transcript · Jan 2026
targetEvidence.text: Capital expenditure for the quarter was ₹ 3.4 billion, taking the 9M FY26 total to ₹ 10.9 billion, in-line with our Project Spring guidance of investing ₹ 12 billion to ₹ 16 billion annually through FY30.

actualEvidence.title: Earnings-call transcript · May 2026
actualEvidence.text: During FY26, we incurred capex of INR 14.8 billion, in line with our annual guidance of INR 12 billion to INR 16 billion per annum.

results.basis: Company earnings presentation; EBITDA excludes other income; PAT excludes exceptional items and discontinued operations

evidence.title: Polycab India Limited has informed the Exchange about Earnings Presentation on Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
evidence.text: Normalized transcription of the consolidated P&L table. Q2 FY27 / Q1 FY27 / Q2 FY26, INR million: Revenue 98,989 / 82,097 / 64,772; EBITDA 14,225 / 11,362 / 10,207; PBT 13,062 / 10,582 / 9,210; PAT 9,900 / 7,967 / 6,930.

guidance.speaker: Shiv Walia, CFO
guidance.note: FY27 is not complete as of 15 November 2026. Quarterly results are not comparable to an annual growth target. July guidance excluded acquisitions; October company-level guidance includes 87 basis points inorganic contribution, so do not compare ranges without preserving the basis change.

targetEvidence.title: Earnings-call transcript · Oct 2026
targetEvidence.text: For FY27, constant currency revenue growth is expected to be between 3% to 4% for the Services business and at the Company level the revenue growth is expected to be between 2.5% to 4%. The full -year revenue growth guidance now includes inorganic contribution of 62 basis points for Services and 87 basis points for the Company.

results.basis: Ind AS; PAT attributable to owners of the company

metrics.name: EBITDA
